channels.name: Million Dollar Plumber
channels.description: Richard Behney, who grew two plumbing service companies from kitchen-table startups to profitable, industry-leading brands (and sold both) before starting this channel in 2018. Focused entirely on the business side — pricing, systems, and scale — not repair tutorials.
channels.verificationMethod: Confirmed via direct channel description plus independent corroboration (ServiceTitan's professional-channel roundup, FieldEdge's 'channels business owners actually learn from' list, which specifically names this as one of the 3 highest-value channels for plumbing business owners).

channels.name: Roger Wakefield Plumbing Education
channels.description: 'The Expert Plumber' — 720K subscribers, ~40 years experience. Blends technical expertise with business insight and leadership perspective, aimed specifically at owners, not just technicians.
channels.verificationMethod: Confirmed via direct channel fetch plus independent corroboration (FieldEdge names this the #1 channel for plumbing business owners specifically, distinct from its DIY-repair value).

blogs.name: Plumbing & Mechanical (PM) Magazine
blogs.verificationMethod: Confirmed real, established BNP Media trade publication with an explicit RSS feed page (pmmag.com/rss) listing dozens of topic-specific feeds, including one described specifically as 'advice and tips for managing your business in the plumbing and heating industry' — used the general feed since the exact business sub-feed URL was truncated in search results.

books.title: Unlock the Full Potential of Your Plumbing Business
books.author: Housecall Pro
books.freeSourceNote: Free ebook, direct from Housecall Pro (a real field-service software company)
books.verificationMethod: Confirmed genuinely free (not a paid title with a teaser). Covers marketing, customer relationships, operations, money management, and scaling — directly matching what this category needs, not just repair technique.

notes: Global content only — no Nigeria-specific plumbing business channel, blog, or book was found this round, despite several individual 'plumber shows his work' human-interest videos existing (Edo State piping tours). Worth another attempt in a future pass with different search terms.
